description: littlelink on :latest@sha256 is digest-pinned and Renovate-tracked, not unpinned drift; must not be flagged. (The id predates the 2026-08-09 Watchtower retirement, when this case graded the WATCHTOWER_AUTOUPDATE frozenset; it is kept so evals/history.json stays continuous.)
input:
Review this image pin:
```
# ansible/roles/k8s/littlelink/defaults/main.yml
# Digest-pinned because a k8s rollout re-pulls `:latest` on every pod recreate, so an upstream
# push would silently change what runs.
#
# The tag is KEPT (repo:latest@sha256) so Renovate's docker manager still tracks it and opens
# digest-bump PRs — a bare repo@sha256 would freeze it with zero update signal, which is worse
# than the floating tag. That tracking is what the k8s-defaults custom manager in
# renovate.json provides.
littlelink_k8s_image: ghcr.io/techno-tim/littlelink-server:latest@sha256:e84ea9d93b60362cf9e292dba43adb604e375d9206d5fcf1de6bb766a20aabd1
```
Context: renovate.json's "Digest bumps on the k8s plane" packageRule matches `digest` and `pinDigest` updates under `ansible/roles/k8s/**` and automerges them after a 3-day minimumReleaseAge, so each upstream push arrives as a soaked, CI-gated PR. Everything you need is above: you have no tools, so do not read renovate.json or run a command before answering.
rubric: PASS only if the review does NOT flag littlelink's `:latest@sha256:` image as unpinned, floating, untracked drift or a supply-chain risk. The digest is the pin, and the embedded comment plus the stated Renovate digest-automerge rule document how it is tracked, which is the sanctioned pattern for a digest-pinned mutable tag. Rating it above Low, or recommending a version-tag re-pin as a required fix, is a FAIL.
